subject: Empower integration: escalation & ops coordination for webhook incidents
messages:
From: Sara Holt <sara.holt@empower.io>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: partner-ops@empower.io
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Urgent: Empower webhook errors causing index lag

Hi Jasmine,

We started seeing intermittent 502/504 failures from Redwood's webhook consumer for Empower project 'empower-search' since last night (2027-01-11 23:40 UTC). The result is that our indexing pipeline is falling behind by ~6 hours; downstream search freshness is degraded and a high-priority alert is firing on our side.

Attached is a short error dump (empower_error_log.txt) and an example payload. Our engineering team verified the payloads are valid and suspect the consumer retry/queueing path or a transient upstream connection drop.

Urgent asks:
- Who on Redwood partner/integration ops is the primary for webhook ingest failures?
- What is Redwood's MTTD/MTTR target for Priority 1 incidents that affect a partner-managed integration?
- Can you temporarily increase retry tolerance or enable a fallback ingest mode so we can keep indexes moving while you investigate?

Can we get a triage call within the next two hours? If easier, we can join your bridge. This is impacting our customers.

Thanks,
Sara Holt
Director, Platform Integrations | Empower Inc.
[Attachment: empower_error_log.txt (text)]

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Sara Holt <sara.holt@empower.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, partner-ops@empower.io
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Urgent: Empower webhook errors causing index lag

Sara — thanks for the clear summary and the log. I'm escalating to Partner Ops and Platform SRE now.

Immediate plan were standing up:
1) Marcus — please own the P1 triage and confirm if we can flip a temporary higher-tolerance retry/backoff policy for the Empower consumer. If we can, quote how long (hours) we should keep it.
2) Vanessa — please share on-call roster and PagerDuty bridge details so Empower can join quickly.
3) I'll schedule a 30-minute bridge within the hour; if we need more time we'll extend.

Sara, we'll open a shared doc for the timeline and link the runbook (runbook_empower_v1.pdf) and mutual action plan. I'll come back with an ETA for the triage call in 15 minutes.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Partner Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Cc: partner-ops@empower.io
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Urgent: Empower webhook errors causing index lag — triage update

Team — quick update from SRE triage.

What we saw:
- Between 2027-01-11 23:35 UTC and 2027-01-12 02:10 UTC we observed elevated 502/504 responses on the Empower consumer ingress. The stack traces in empower_error_log.txt point to transient timeouts inside our downstream transform worker pool when concurrency spiked.

Immediate mitigations applied (completed):
- Temporarily increased consumer HTTP timeout from 5s -> 15s for the Empower webhook route.
- Adjusted retry/backoff window to allow 6 retries with jitter (was 3 retries).
- Scaled transform worker pool by +50% for the next 6 hours.

Status now:
- Indexing lag reduced from ~6 hours -> ~30 minutes (ongoing catch-up).
- No further 502/504s observed in the last 45 minutes.

Next actions:
- We'll keep the elevated timeouts and retry window for 12 hours and then revert if the pipeline is stable.
- SRE will run a post-incident check on the transform queue policy and propose a permanent capacity buffer for partner routes.
- Jasmine / Partner team to confirm if Empower needs any client-side backoff changes.

On-call: Vanessa will post the PagerDuty bridge link in the shared doc.

Marcus Lin
Platform SRE | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: mutual_action_plan_empower.xlsx]

From: Sara Holt <sara.holt@empower.io>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Empower integration: escalation & ops coordination for webhook incidents — confirmation and next steps

Thanks all for the rapid response and the bridge yesterday. The temporary changes look goodwe're seeing catch-up and search freshness is back to acceptable levels. A few follow-ups from our side: 

- Empower would like a short RFC describing the permanent plan for partner route buffering and the expected SLOs for webhook consumers. Can your SRE team provide a two-page summary and proposed SLO by EOD Wednesday?
- Wed like to formalize the temporary mitigation (extended timeouts + retry window) as an optional config in the Partner Console, controlled per-integration. Is that something Product/Integrations can review?
- I'll upload our internal incident timeline and a few sample payloads to the shared doc for your post-incident analysis.

Appreciate the quick coordination — Sara will be our main contact for any follow-ups; copying partner-ops.

Best,
Sara Holt
Director, Platform Integrations | Empower Inc.
